content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides rules on how a contracting authority may publish procurement notices to locations other than the UK e-notification service (provided by Find a Tender).
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: In addition to publishing procurement notices on the UK e-notification service (regulation 51 PCR 2015), contracting authorities may publish the information contained in them on the internet on a buyer profile.
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: A buyer profile may include:
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: information relating to ongoing invitations to tender, scheduled purchases, contracts concluded, procedures cancelled, and
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: general information, such as a contact point, a telephone and a fax number, a postal address and an e-mail address.
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities are required to publish procurement notices on the UK e-notification service before they can be published to any other location (except where the contracting authority does not receive a publication confirmation within 48 hours of the notice being submitted).
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Subject to limited exceptions, where a contracting authority intends to publish a contract award notice in relation to the termination of a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) pursuant to Regulation 34, this must first be published on Find a Tender before it can be published to any other location.
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities:
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service

content_blocks.text: may publish a notice in relation to the termination of a DPS on its buyer profile subject to certain conditions
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: may include on a buyer profile useful general information, such as a contact point, a telephone and a fax number, a postal address and an e-mail address
heading_path: Publication otherwise than on the UK e-notification service
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: may not publish a notice in relation to the termination of a DPS on a buyer profile or any other location, unless such a notice has first been published on Find a Tender (subject to limited exceptions).
